title: feat(spec, objectql, runtime): the in-product AI path can name itself on ExecutionContext.performedBy, and hooks see it on HookContext.provenance
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi93QWxWQ7bNzeUg7g48SSecH)_

Fixes #33786

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim by `domain:spec#2` (6896038213). The spec half of #33694 (cloud#3826 phase 2). Ruling-ref: the account owner on objectstack-ai/cloud#3826, 「3826 照建议（征询版）」 (decision request 6890278459), as carried in the #33694 body: "Accept AI-on-behalf, conversation id and confirmation id on the write context, using the existing `performed_by` / `on_behalf_of` columns plus contract fields. Do not add a new actor vocabulary."

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：写入上下文 `ExecutionContext.performedBy` 在 `clientId` 旁新增 `agentId`、`conversationId`、`confirmationId` 三个可选键；hook 上下文 `provenance` 同步新增三个对应标记，引擎和沙箱都会带过去。
- 为什么改：产品内 AI 以本人身份写数据，之前写入上下文没有位置标明「是 AI 替本人做的、哪次对话、哪次确认」，而且引擎解析时会把多出来的键丢掉，审计日志无从记录。
- 风险与回滚：只放宽，原来只带 `clientId` 的上下文解析结果不变；`clientId` 在类型上变为可选，读它的 TypeScript 代码需判空（第一方读者都已判空）。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/kernel/execution-context.zod.ts` 的 `performedBy` 块，`packages/objectql/src/engine-execution-plumbing.ts` 的 `buildProvenance`，`packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts` 的 `provenance`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/engine.test.ts -t "in-product AI performer"`，预期 2 条全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。审计日志写入那一半在 #33694，ADR-0090 D10 第 4 条的补注由 skills 车道另行提交。

## What changes

- **`packages/spec/src/kernel/execution-context.zod.ts`** (`performedBy`): three optional sibling keys beside `clientId`.
  - `agentId`: the in-product AI agent that performed the write for the signed-in person. Same value as `ToolExecutionContext.agentId` (the agent the chat runs as). Never a `sys_user` id or an OAuth client id, so one key never holds two id namespaces.
  - `conversationId`: same id as `ToolExecutionContext.conversationId`.
  - `confirmationId`: the id of the pending item the person's approval decided, i.e. the in-app pending action id (`IAIService.proposePendingAction`'s `id`, the seam #33808 aligns) or the pending-confirmation service's `ActionConfirmationPending.pendingId`. Absent when no confirmation was needed.
  - `clientId` is now optional, because the shape forces it: the in-product AI has no OAuth client. The object takes `.refine(requiredOneOf(['clientId', 'agentId']))`, so a `performedBy` naming no performer is still refused at parse, as it was when `clientId` was required. The rule is on the projectable closed list, so the published JSON Schema states it (`allOf: [{ anyOf: [{ required: [clientId] }, { required: [agentId] }] }]`) and `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` does not grow.
  - The docblock and `.describe` stop saying "Set only at the /mcp OAuth door". They name both producers: the `/mcp` OAuth door (`clientId`) and the server-constructed in-product AI path acting for and running as the signed-in person (`agentId` + `conversationId` + `confirmationId`). The ruling chain is cited in the jsdoc only. Kept as is: server-constructed only, never client-supplied; attribution only; never the authorization subject; `userId` stays the person; no `onBehalfOf` on the in-product path, since the write runs on the person's own grants. The ADR-0090 2026-09-20 room for an agent-run id stays reserved; `conversationId` is not that id.
  - The in-product producer's duty (review S1): its ids can start as values a request named (the chat route's `:agentName`, a continued conversation, the pending item an approval names). It stamps one only after the server resolved it in its own store for the person in `userId`: `agentId` the agent it actually ran, `conversationId` a conversation that person owns, `confirmationId` a pending item that person's approval decided for this operation. An unresolved id is not stamped.
  - The audit writer (review S2): the descriptions say the audit writer records `clientId` as `performed_by` beside `on_behalf_of`, which is true today, and that the in-product keys are carried for it and not recorded yet. How they are recorded is #33694's.
- **`packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts`** (`HookContext.provenance`): `performedByAgentId`, `performedByConversationId`, `performedByConfirmationId`, flattened the way `performedByClientId` copies `clientId`. The provenance docblock goes from four marks to five.
- **`packages/objectql/src/engine-execution-plumbing.ts`** (`buildProvenance`): copies the three keys. Its own docblock says a key declared on `hook.zod.ts` and missing there is declared and never populated (ADR-0049), so the spec keys need this copy to be live.
- **`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts`** and **`script-runner.ts`**: the sandboxed body face carries the three marks member by member, like the other four, so a lowered hook body reads them on `ctx.provenance` too.
- Not touched: `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/**` (the writer half stays on #33694), `docs/adr/**`, the MCP door (`packages/core/src/security/assemble-execution-context.ts` still sets `{ clientId }` alone).
- Why the widening is needed, not only declared: `ObjectQL#createContext` runs `ExecutionContextSchema.parse(ctx)`, which keeps declared keys only. On main an `agentId` a host put on `performedBy` was dropped there.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/kernel/execution-context.test.ts`, a new top-level describe. CONTROL: `{ clientId }` alone parses unchanged. The three new keys survive a parse. A write with no confirmation parses. `{}`, `{ conversationId }` and `{ confirmationId }` are refused at path `performedBy`. A non-string `agentId` is refused. The description names both producers and no longer says "Set only at the /mcp OAuth door".
- `packages/spec/src/data/hook.test.ts`, a new top-level describe. CONTROL: `performedByClientId` alone parses unchanged. The three marks survive a parse. A non-string mark is refused.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine.test.ts`, a new describe at the engine seam. A write whose context carries `performedBy: { agentId, conversationId, confirmationId }` reaches a `beforeInsert` hook with the three `provenance` marks, and `session` stays the person with no `performedBy`. CONTROL: `{ clientId }` alone still gives `provenance: { performedByClientId }`.
- **Forced test edit**: `packages/cli/test/lowered-body-face-enumeration.test.ts` pins the in-process and body `provenance` member sets. Both now list seven members instead of four.

## Acceptance notes

- Key names are the seat's call. `agentId` and `conversationId` reuse `ToolExecutionContext` vocabulary. `confirmationId` follows the card and ruling wording; `pendingId` (the `ActionConfirmationPending` key) is the alternative. The hook-side names follow the `performedBy` + key prefix of `performedByClientId`.
- The type reader face: `ExecutionContext['performedBy']['clientId']` is `string | undefined` now. Every first-party reader already checks it (`apiForwardAgentOf`, the MCP interceptor, the three plugin-audit writers, objectql). The changeset says so for outside readers.
- `Metadata-protocol: none`: `ExecutionContext` is server-constructed and `HookContext.provenance` is server-stamped, so a metadata author writes neither. No `authorable-surface/` shard moved. The #31740 precedent took `added` for `HookContext.session.principalKind`; the seat may read this the same way, which would raise spec to `minor`.
- The ADR-0090 D10 rule 4 text names the agent principal only. The ADR-0090/0151 note recording the in-product AI case is carried by #34057 (ADR-0090 D10 rule 4, ADR-0151 "Leaves unchanged", and the 2026-09-20 one-key note).
- The audit writer mapping (what `performed_by` holds for an in-product AI row) is #33694's. ADR-0151 D5 refused putting a second id namespace into one `performed_by` key, so the writer should keep the agent id apart from OAuth client ids in the row.
- Note for #33694 (review N2): `confirmationId` is one key over two stores, the in-app pending action id and the pending-confirmation service item id. Which store an id names follows from the performer key beside it, and #33694 should say so when it records the id.
- Accepted deviations from the contract review (record 6897691839): N1, the schema admits `{ clientId, agentId }` although no producer builds it; N3, a performer-less `performedBy` is now refused at path `performedBy` with a custom code instead of `invalid_type` at `performedBy.clientId`.

## Verification

Head and readings are listed in the os-dev-report on #33786. Every heavy run went under `os-verify-lock`.

Round 2 (review S1, S2), at `bfaef935`, changes prose only: the two `.zod.ts` docblocks and descriptions, and the three regenerated reference pages. Spec pins 146/146 and `check:generated` are green there. `ceeec029` merges main `b4ce310b`, and the round 2 contract review (6898426121) is on that head.

Current head `75dcf734` is a merge-only commit made under the seat's K ≥ 15 landing rule. It merges main `529ed7d9` into `ceeec029` with no hand resolution, and all 13 PR files are byte-identical to `ceeec029` (+311/-49). On it, the spec build, `check:generated` (14/14 up to date) and the spec pins (146/146) are green.

<details><summary>Consumer test runs (branch at ca6e40c9, before the main merge)</summary>

- spec 842 files / 26965 passed (1 todo). objectql 596 / 13174. core 147 / 3402. mcp 65 / 1185. rest 412 / 8442 (332 skipped). plugin-audit 94 / 1541. runtime 605 / 10958 (19 skipped). plugin-auth 277 / 5485 (10 skipped). cli: `test/lowered-body-face-enumeration.test.ts` (unit) 4 / 4; the rest of the cli unit layer is left to CI.
- Typecheck of spec, objectql, runtime, core, mcp, rest, plugin-audit, plugin-auth and cli: all exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>After merging main 0ac112fc (head 93b0b119), and again b4ce310b (head ceeec029)</summary>

- `check:generated`: all 14 artifacts up to date. Closure build 113/113.
- Rerun: spec pins 146/146, objectql `engine.test.ts` 138/138, cli face test 4/4, runtime `hook-provenance-signal.integration.test.ts` 1/1, objectql and runtime typecheck exit 0.
- The same reruns on `ceeec029` were all green, and `dispatch-gates` there gave 118 derived, 118 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored with blob == HEAD and git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

1. objectql `buildProvenance` stops copying `agentId`: `engine.test.ts` "copies agentId, conversationId and confirmationId onto provenance" red.
2. spec `.refine(requiredOneOf(...))` becomes `.refine(() => true)`: "REJECTS a performedBy naming no performer" red (1 failed / 45).
3. body-runner drops the `performedByAgentId` projection: cli face test 3 failed / 4.
4. Type reverse check against the rebuilt spec dist, in objectql: a typed `performedBy: { agentId, probeBogusKey }` gives TS2353 on `probeBogusKey` only, while `{ agentId, conversationId, confirmationId }` and a reader of `performedBy?.agentId` compile. The probe file was deleted.

</details>
